The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the limit where Q T /Q → 0, one-loop corrections factorize in a manner that is consistent with collinear factorization at leading order.
, at one-loop order, factorization is not broken by the exchange of a gluon between the two incoming hadrons, even though the gluon is not collinear to the incoming hadrons.

, at leading order, the factorization of the Drell-Yann cross section in terms of partonic cross sections and parton distribution functions is exact, and the partonic cross sections can be computed in a factorized manner, with the partonic hard-scattering functions and parton distribution amplitudes.
